project_info.name: Perfectly Good
project_info.description: A mobile app connecting users with discounted surplus food from local restaurants.

typography.font_loading_instructions: Use @expo-google-fonts/outfit and @expo-google-fonts/dm-sans. Apply Outfit for all titles/headings and DM Sans for body text, inputs, and buttons.

layout_and_spacing.bottom_tab_bar: React Navigation Bottom Tabs. Active icon tint: #2E7D32, Inactive tint: #9CA3AF. Tab bar background: #FFFFFF. Remove top border or use a subtle #E5E7EB shadow.

components.FoodDropCard: Use View with backgroundColor #FFFFFF, borderRadius 16, and overflow hidden. Top Image should be large (height ~200) spanning full width. Title in Outfit, subtitle/distance in DM Sans.
components.FloatingBadge: Absolute positioning (e.g., top 12, right 12), backgroundColor #C65D47, rounded full, padding horizontal 12, padding vertical 4, white text. Ideal for 'Only 2 Left!'.
components.PrimaryButton: TouchableOpacity with backgroundColor #2E7D32, borderRadius 12, height 48, justifyContent center, alignItems center. Text should be white, Outfit font, semi-bold.
components.UrgentButton: TouchableOpacity with backgroundColor #C65D47. Use this for reserving low-quantity drops or critical alerts.
components.Input: TextInput with backgroundColor #FFFFFF, borderColor #E5E7EB, borderWidth 1, borderRadius 12, padding 16, fontFamily DM Sans.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use native stack screen transitions (slide-from-right or default iOS/Android native transition).
motion_and_interactions.button_press: Use TouchableOpacity activeOpacity 0.8 to give tactile feedback on button presses.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react-native for a clean, consistent set of icons. Fallback to @expo/vector-icons (Feather) if necessary.

Sliced vegetables in bowl beside breads

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo application, strictly use native components (View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, Image) and NOT web HTML tags like div or span.
Do not use Shadcn web components. Create custom native components as described in the guidelines.

Map web Tailwind concepts to NativeWind or React Native StyleSheet depending on the setup. If creating StyleSheets, follow the exact hex codes provided: Primary #2E7D32, Background #FDFBF7, Urgent #C65D47.
Set up navigation using @react-navigation/native and @react-navigation/bottom-tabs. Include standard routing for Login, Home, Drop Detail, Checkout, My Orders, Profile, and Vendor/Admin dashboards.
Use testID prop on all interactive elements. Example: <TouchableOpacity testID='login-button'>
Implement the floating badges over the food images using absolute positioning to indicate urgency (e.g., '2 left').
Integrate a mock or actual flow for Razorpay checkout when reserving a food drop.
Ensure large food images are prominent on the Home Feed and Drop Detail screens, maintaining the requested 'mobile-native feel with smooth transitions'.
